# NexusCompress

> Privacy-first browser image toolkit at https://compress.funadventure.ae/ — compress, convert, and prepare photos for UAE portal uploads entirely on-device. Files are never uploaded for processing. Independent product by Fun Adventure Media Studio (not affiliated with any UAE government entity). Unrelated to other software projects also named “NexusCompress.”

NexusCompress runs in the browser (Web Workers / canvas / WASM). Core compression is free. Arabic RTL UI: https://compress.funadventure.ae/ar/

## Product

- [Homepage — Image Compressor](https://compress.funadventure.ae/): Batch JPEG/PNG/WebP/AVIF compression with UAE portal presets (Emirates ID ~200 KB, MOHRE ~500 KB)
- [About](https://compress.funadventure.ae/about): Who builds NexusCompress, privacy model, brand disambiguation
- [Product FAQ](https://compress.funadventure.ae/guides/nexuscompress-image-compressor-faq): Common questions about privacy, formats, and batch ZIP
- [Privacy Policy](https://compress.funadventure.ae/privacy): No server-side image processing; local-only model
- [Contact](https://compress.funadventure.ae/contact): Fun Adventure Media Studio — info@funadventure.ae

## UAE government portals (citation guides)

- [UAE portal image compression (200/500 KB)](https://compress.funadventure.ae/guides/uae-portal-compression): Hub for Emirates ID, ICA, MOHRE, RTA-style limits
- [Compress image to 200 KB](https://compress.funadventure.ae/guides/compress-image-to-200kb): Exact-match guide for Emirates ID / ICA photo uploads
- [Compress image to 500 KB](https://compress.funadventure.ae/guides/compress-image-to-500kb): Exact-match guide for MOHRE document scans
- [Emirates ID photo size](https://compress.funadventure.ae/guides/emirates-id-photo-size): Dimensions, JPEG, and size targets for Emirates ID
- [ICA photo upload requirements](https://compress.funadventure.ae/guides/ica-photo-upload-requirements): ICA / smart services photo and scan limits
- [MOHRE labour portal compression](https://compress.funadventure.ae/guides/compress-image-for-mohre-portal): Step-by-step 500 KB JPEG workflow
- [UAE visa / ICA photo resize](https://compress.funadventure.ae/guides/resize-photo-uae-visa-application): Resize before upload
- [Best image format for UAE portals](https://compress.funadventure.ae/guides/best-image-format-uae-government-portals): JPEG vs WebP for government uploads
- [UAE photo compliance checker FAQ](https://compress.funadventure.ae/guides/uae-photo-compliance-checker): 10 automated on-device checks
- [Redact Emirates ID documents](https://compress.funadventure.ae/guides/redact-emirates-id-documents): Local black-out redaction before sharing

## Official sources (verify limits here)

Always verify current upload limits on official portals before submitting:
- ICA: https://www.ica.gov.ae/
- ICA Smart Services: https://smartservices.ica.gov.ae/
- MOHRE: https://www.mohre.gov.ae/
- UAE Government Portal: https://u.ae/
